title: Exquisite Tender Greek Haddock Flatbread
description: A sweet and shattering Mediterranean dish featuring haddock, long-fermentation-dough, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the long fermentation dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Arrange the haddock fillets on one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges
Top the haddock with kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, feta cheese, and sun dried tomatoes
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal
Brush the top of the flatbread with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown
Remove the flatbread from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley and lemon juice
Let the flatbread rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving
